verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Box's content APIs (uploads, shared links, collaborations, search, metadata, webhooks, events, AI, e-signature, MCP) but contains no documentation of admin-specific endpoints for member/user provisioning or group management (e.g., Users API, Groups API, Enterprise admin console API) — only a generic /users/me call is shown, which is not an admin provisioning endpoint. Missing for 10: documented Users API for creating/deactivating accounts, Groups API for group membership management, and enterprise admin console API references for automation.
